# widgetz 🚀

Tired of boring widgets? Say hi to widgetz! ✨ It's the fun way to build, ship and show off your widgets! 🎉

## Why you'll love it 💜

- One command and you're done! 🎯
- Zero config, zero drama! 😎
- Works on your laptop, your server, your toaster! 🍞

Give it a spin! We can't wait to see what you build! 🙌
